rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the main room where people relax and socialise at home.

example.english: We’re watching the match in the living room tonight, so there’s no need to go to the bedroom.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚喺客廳睇波，唔使入房。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 haak3 teng1 tai2 bo1 m4 sai2 jap6 fong4
